market.question: Will the highest temperature in Jakarta be 34°C on May 1?

assessment.reasoning: Jakarta Halim Perdanakusuma climatological highs in May average ~32°C, with weather25 forecast showing 29°C with light drizzle on May 1 specifically. The market needs the high to land exactly in the 34°C bucket — well above both the climatological average and the day-of forecast. Probability ~10-18%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast may be conservative; a clear humid day in early dry-season transition could push high to 33-34°C.
